skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator, including cases where the result is zero.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Find equivalent fractions with a common denominator in order to subtract fractions with different denominators.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions from mixed numbers when the fractional part of the minuend is sufficient and no borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Regrouping for subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction when subtracting from a whole number or when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.

skills.name: Improper parts in mixed numbers
skills.definition: Interpret or convert mixed numbers that contain improper fractional parts before subtracting.
